item.title: Minnesota legislators face pressure ease pain of SNAP cuts
item.description: New eligibility requirements and federal funding cuts for SNAP benefits are leaving thousands of Minnesotans turning to food shelves.

item.title: Selfies, surprise visits, secret codes: A third-party monitoring company flips Minnesota immigrants’ lives upside down
item.description: BI Incorporated and The Geo Group, a third-party contractor with ICE, monitors Minnesota’s immigrants with ankle bracelets, phone calls and home visits.

item.title: Federal judge pauses Trump termination of TPS for Somalis
item.description: U.S. District Judge Allison D. Burroughs’ ruling said there would be “weighty” consequences if Somalia's TPS designation was allowed to expire.

item.title: As Operation Metro Surge disrupted learning, students pushed back
item.description: A bill to restore “sensitive location” protections limiting immigration enforcement on school property has advanced in the Minnesota Senate and stalled in the House. Lawmakers vow to keep pushing for action.

item.title: Judge ends asylum claims for Liam Conejo Ramos and his family
item.description: An immigration judge has ended the asylum claims of Liam Conejo Ramos and his family, according to their Minneapolis lawyer.

item.title: Vietnamese folklore meets Midwestern landscapes in U of M show
item.description: Things to do in the Twin Cities this weekend: Afrofuturist dance at the Walker, new Black-owned studios in Rondo; and two shows trace the Hmong and Vietnamese American experience.

item.title: How a Minneapolis corner store served immigrants hiding from ICE
item.description: When ICE kept their customers away, the owners of Amigos One Stop immediately pivoted to delivering food and other necessities to customers.

item.title: Labor shortage expected for spring, summer construction season after immigration enforcement
item.description: A shortage in construction labor is expected this spring and summer in the Twin Cities after Operation Metro Surge arrested and deported workers.

item.title: ICE agents oversee TSA checkpoints amid partial shutdown
item.description: On Sunday, the Trump administration signaled it would deploy federal immigration officers to large airports with the longest wait times.

item.title: Minnesota House votes to repeal César Chávez Day amid rape allegations
item.description: The Minnesota House voted Monday to repeal César Chávez Day and St. Paul is considering renaming a street named after him.

item.title: Activists plan hunger strike to push Hennepin board to close HERC incinerator
item.description: Activists are going on a hunger strike to compel the Hennepin Board of Commissioners to pick a closure date for the HERC incinerator.

item.title: Minnesota officials sue feds for evidence in Good, Pretti killings
item.description: Minnesota Attorney General Keith Ellison and Hennepin County Attorney Mary Moriarty sue the federal government to access evidence in the killings of Renee Good and Alex Pretti.

item.title: Minnesota faces long road of recovery after ICE damage
item.description: ICE operations upended communities across Minnesota, leaving leaders and advocates assessing how to respond to widespread disruption and economic damage.
